2607.05297.title: MetaSkill-Evolve: Recursive Self-Improvement of LLM Agents via Two-Timescale Meta-Skill Evolution
2607.05297.paper_summary: Recent LLM agents tackle increasingly long-horizon, open-ended tasks, and external skills, reusable procedural knowledge supplied to the agent, further extend this capability. However, a fixed, hand-authored skill is rarely optimal, and cannot adapt to the diversity of tasks an agent encounters. Self-improving agents address this by rewriting their own skill files from execution traces, yielding meaningful gains on challenging benchmarks. Yet such self-evolution remains non-recursive: it improves only the task skill (what the agent does) while the improvement procedure (how it improves) is authored once and held fixed. We introduce MetaSkill-Evolve, a two-timescale framework that makes agentic skill improvement recursive: every branch carries both a task skill $s$ and a branch-local meta-skill $m=(ψ,σ,α,π,\varepsilon)$ whose five components parameterise the Analyzer, Retriever, Allocator, Proposer, and Evolver agents of the improvement pipeline. Task skills evolve on a fast loop while the meta-skill evolves on a slower one under the same pipeline applied to itself, with no additional model or objective. With all five pipeline agents sharing a single frozen backbone, MetaSkill-Evolve outperforms no-skill, static-skill, and single-level evolution baselines on three agentic benchmarks (OfficeQA, SealQA, ALFWorld), improving held-out test accuracy over the raw backbone by +23.54, +16.09, and +1.92 points respectively.
2607.05297.paper_summary_zh: 最近的LLM代理處理越來越長期、開放式的任務，而外部技能、可重用的程序知識供應給代理，進一步擴展了這一能力。<lb/>然而，固定的手工編寫技能很少是最佳的，並且無法適應代理所遇到的任務多樣性。<lb/>自我改進的代理通過從執行痕跡中重寫自己的技能文件來解決這個問題，從而在挑戰性基準上獲得有意義的增益。<lb/>然而，這種自我演化仍然是非遞歸的：它僅改善任務技能（代理所做的），而改善程序（它如何改善）則是一次性編寫並保持固定。<lb/>我們引入了MetaSkill-Evolve，一個雙時間尺度框架，使代理技能改進變得遞歸：每個分支同時包含一個任務技能$s$和一個分支本地元技能$m=(ψ,σ,α,π,\varepsilon)$，其五個組件參數化了改進流程中的分析器、檢索器、分配器、提議者和演化者代理。<lb/>任務技能在快速循環中演變，而元技能在同一流程下以較慢的速度演變，無需額外的模型或目標。<lb/>在所有五個流程代理共享一個固定的骨幹的情況下，MetaSkill-Evolve在三個代理基準（OfficeQA、SealQA、ALFWorld）上超越了無技能、靜態技能和單層演化基準，將持出測試準確率分別提高了+23.54、+16.09和+1.92點。
